title: A Suitable Boy
author: Vikram Seth
summary: In newly independent India of the early 1950s, Mrs Rupa Mehra is determined to find a husband for her daughter Lata. Four families and a first general election form the backdrop to a huge social novel.
readIf: you have time for an immersive, Victorian-style doorstop of Indian family life.
skipIf: you want a quick read, since it runs close to 1,500 pages in most editions.
